examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{体力|たいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくなって→無くなる：01101_nakunaru⟧⟦くる→来る：00254_kuru⟧。

notes:
{体力|たいりょく} refers to overall physical strength, stamina, and fitness — the body's capacity for exertion and endurance.

- {体力|たいりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: stamina declines
- {体力|たいりょく}⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧: physical fitness test
- {体力|たいりょく}⟦{的|てき}に→〜的：09839_teki⟧: physically (in terms of stamina)
- {体力|たいりょく}⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧: a contest of endurance
